instruction_covers: Switching a Kraken history event to a custom asset must not break fetching/displaying the Kraken history events list
The edit itself succeeds; the failure happens when events are fetched or displayed afterwards
Custom assets already work elsewhere, so they should be usable on Kraken events too
label: suspect
notes: Repo verified: serialize() (base.py:281-303) builds all eight Kraken notes templates via resolve_to_asset_with_symbol().symbol; CustomAsset is AssetWithNameAndType, not AssetWithSymbol (asset.py:397), so it raises WrongAssetType and serialization crashes. The adjacent helper Asset.symbol_or_name() (asset.py:181) returns the symbol or the name and is byte-identical for regular assets; grep surfaces all eight call sites in the same function and one substitution fixes them with no new semantics (R2). The templates pre-exist but the name-substitution behavior does not (base crashes), so not R1/R3; per the sound-vs-suspect tie-break there is genuine doubt (a crash-only fix with empty/identifier notes still fails), so the item is listed.
rubric_gap: R5's exact-string rule is written for CLI output substrings and channels and does not say whether it also governs API serialized fields like notes.

unstated.what: Kraken auto-generated notes for custom-asset events must keep the eight existing type/subtype templates with the custom asset's name substituted (e.g. 'Swap 1 Gold Bar in Kraken', 'Receive 1 Gold Bar as a result of a Kraken swap'); a crash-only fix still fails
